classification.difficultyReason: Calculate the two outer sloping sides from the explicitly identified right triangles, then assemble the perimeter using the full base while excluding the shared internal height.

content.prompt: This shape is made up of two right-angled triangles. Find the perimeter of this shape to 2 d.p.

spec.description: An outer triangle divided by its vertical height into two right-angled triangles. The shorter base segment is on the left. Dimension arrows label both base segments, the height and the outer sloping sides. No right-angle squares are supplied.
spec.mathematics: Left triangle legs: 4 cm and 8 cm, hypotenuse x. Right triangle legs: 12 cm and 8 cm, hypotenuse y. The perimeter is x+y+4+12.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens and unknown labels appear in the question diagram.
